input: What did you want to say just now?
reaction: That I wanted the company. I do not have to bring news every time. That is a good line, and new. Hacer gets real warmth on rent day. Pulse lifts a little. Now the shift at 12:45, if it comes.

Hacer warm, rent day close. But the clock is crawling: 8 game minutes in 30 seconds while I sit on his old answer. I think I am being held in the past until I press Back to now. I did not know that mattered.

Found it, buried in Today: 10:00 I pay Osman the rent. I want to keep my promise to Osman. He worked the morning, got to 302 I guess, paid 300, and has 2 lira left. He did it on his own. So it was paid! Relief - but I learned it from a log line and the change of 2 lira, not from a scene. Osman never appears. And I spent my whole worry on 14 lira that one morning covered. Also in the log Riza had his own lines on day 2 - pull your chair closer - that I never saw on screen.

Rent paid, and now immediately: 300 lira is owed by Ramadan 30, he has 2. The same grind starts again with the same shift button. I came back to learn whether Osman got paid; I know now. I do not want to do the second half of the month.

I am stopping here. I came back to find out whether Osman got paid, and he did, on his own at 10:00 on Ramadan 15 - but only a log line told me, and now another 300 is due by Ramadan 30 with 2 lira in his pocket. My own arc is done. I chose I am stopping in Feedback, typed nothing, did not submit. I would not leave it running. I might come back once more another evening on desktop to see Eid, but not to work through the second rent.

Correction to my stop word, not to my words: I wrote FINISHED, but the game did not end - only the thing I came back for did. The honest word is BORED: I understood the second rent and did not want to do it.
